question: Which café can I find inside 20 kilometers along the way toward Painted Ladies, San Francisco, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.432786 37.776224)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, 20000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: My Cup of Tea (Cool Tea Bar)

[3].display_name: The View Lounge, San Francisco, CA

poi.description: 39th floor bar with city views; enter through hotel
